equal_total_source_output_RMS_sum.source_Vpp_definition: Actual full source waveform max-minus-min before50ohm; analytic control or coherent bounds, not per-tone Vpp

signed_per_output_power_evidence.current_scope: Each physical source output RMS over distinct frequencies; not common-GND return current

legacy_composite_full_skin.source_Vpp_definition: Actual full source waveform max-minus-min before50ohm; analytic control or coherent bounds, not per-tone Vpp

signed_per_output_power_evidence.current_scope: Each physical source output RMS over distinct frequencies; not common-GND return current

equal_total_source_output_RMS_sum.interpretation: numerical normalization only; baseline limits are not human safety limits
equal_total_source_output_RMS_sum.source_Vpp_definition: Actual full source waveform max-minus-min before50ohm; analytic control or coherent bounds, not per-tone Vpp

signed_per_output_power_evidence.current_scope: Each physical source output RMS over distinct frequencies; not common-GND return current

skin_contact_only.interpretation: numerical normalization only; baseline limits are not human safety limits
skin_contact_only.source_Vpp_definition: Actual full source waveform max-minus-min before50ohm; analytic control or coherent bounds, not per-tone Vpp

signed_per_output_power_evidence.definition: Peak phasors: Videal=Vmetal+50I; P=.5Re(V*conj(I)); resistor=50|I|^2/2; RMS=sqrt(sum_f|I|^2/2)

equal_total_power.interpretation: numerical normalization only; baseline limits are not human safety limits
equal_total_power.source_Vpp_definition: Actual full source waveform max-minus-min before50ohm; analytic control or coherent bounds, not per-tone Vpp
